after_home.name: Me
after_home.text: *I walk through the darkened streets. The streetlights cast long shadows across the road.*

after_home_walk.name: Me
after_home_walk.text: *This neighborhood is starting to feel a little familiar already. Past the alley by the convenience store is my house... and I noticed that vending machine earlier too.*

after_home_neighborhood.name: Me
after_home_neighborhood.text: *A quiet residential area. The smell of dinner drifts from somewhere nearby. It's an unfamiliar neighborhood... so why does it feel so comfortable?*

after_home_arrive.name: Me
after_home_arrive.text: *I've arrived at the front door. I fish the key out of my pocket and unlock it. Looks like my parents aren't home yet.*

after_home_2.name: Me
after_home_2.text: *I flick on the light in my room and flop onto the bed. The unfamiliar ceiling feels oddly cozy tonight... maybe it's just the mood.*

after_home_settle.name: Me
after_home_settle.text: *I change out of my uniform into something comfortable. I set down my bag and organize the handouts I got today on the desk.*

after_home_3.name: Me
after_home_3.text: *What's waiting for me tomorrow? A strange excitement makes me feel like sleep won't come easily tonight.*

night_reflect_start.name: Me
night_reflect_start.text: *I stare at the ceiling, thinking back on the day. For a first day at a new school... a lot really happened.*

night_reflect_seoyeon.name: Me
night_reflect_seoyeon.text: *Seoyeon... she was bright and kind. She came up to me without hesitation, even though I was a complete stranger. We're in the same class, so I'll be seeing her a lot. I'm looking forward to it.*

night_reflect_yuna.name: Me
night_reflect_yuna.text: *Yuna... a girl with a mysterious aura. She didn't say much, but I keep thinking about those eyes. What was she thinking...? I want to know more about her.*

night_reflect_dain.name: Me
night_reflect_dain.text: *Dain... so full of energy. I don't think I'd ever be bored around her. She looked really cool playing volleyball.*

night_reflect_nurse.name: Me
night_reflect_nurse.text: *The school nurse had... how do I put it, a certain charm. I kind of want to visit again.*

night_reflect_teacher.name: Me
night_reflect_teacher.text: *The homeroom teacher was surprisingly caring. I'm glad to have someone like her as my teacher.*

night_reflect_end.name: Me
night_reflect_end.text: *This school might not be so bad after all. I wonder what tomorrow will bring...*

night_diary_choice.name: Me
night_diary_choice.text: *I spot a new notebook in the desk drawer. Did Mom slip it in as a transfer gift...?*

night_diary_write_1.name: Me
night_diary_write_1.text: *I pick up a pen and open to the first page. 'Month X, Day X. First day at the new school. It was better than I expected.'*

night_diary_write_2.name: Me
night_diary_write_2.text: *Wrote in the diary. First day at the new school... Met various people. Don't know what kind of connections they'll turn into yet, but it wasn't a bad day.*

night_diary_write_3.name: Me
night_diary_write_3.text: *'Will I be able to get closer to them tomorrow? I can't wait.' ...I set the pen down and close the notebook. Writing it out helped clear my mind.*

night_home.name: Me
night_home.text: *Before falling asleep, I check my phone out of habit.*

night_home_check_contact.name: Me
night_home_check_contact.text: *The people I exchanged numbers with today... who should I message first?*
choices: Send a message to the School Nurse.
Send a message to the Homeroom Teacher.
Stop messaging and go to sleep.

day1_check_affinity.name: System
day1_check_affinity.text: Here are your current affinity levels with each character.{affinity_list}

night_message_teacher.name: Me
night_message_teacher.text: *I sent a message to the Homeroom Teacher. 'Thank you for looking after me today, Teacher. I think I adjusted well on my first day thanks to you!'*

night_message_teacher_reply.name: Homeroom Teacher
night_message_teacher_reply.text: *A warm reply arrived.* 'Oh my, {name}! It must have been tough on your first day as a transfer student, and you even sent a message like this. How sweet.'

night_message_teacher_extra_1.name: Homeroom Teacher
night_message_teacher_extra_1.text: 'By the way, I noticed an expression on your face during class today... were you thinking about something funny? I saw everything.'

night_message_teacher_extra_2.name: Me
night_message_teacher_extra_2.text: *Uh oh... she noticed? I type a reply. 'Oh, that was... the classroom was so different from my old school, I was just fascinated!'*

night_message_teacher_extra_3.name: Homeroom Teacher
night_message_teacher_extra_3.text: 'Haha, I see. Anyway, the real start is tomorrow, so take care of yourself and get a good rest. See you tomorrow!'

night_message_teacher_extra_4.name: Me
night_message_teacher_extra_4.text: *What a warm person... I'm glad to have a homeroom teacher like her. I set my phone down with a small smile.*

night_message_seyoun_lunch.name: Me
night_message_seyoun_lunch.text: *I sent a message to Seoyeon. 'I really enjoyed having lunch together today. Thanks, Seoyeon.'*

night_message_seyoun_after.name: Me
night_message_seyoun_after.text: *I sent a message to Seoyeon. 'I had fun helping with the student council stuff today. Hope it wasn't too tiring for you? See you tomorrow!'*

night_message_seyoun_generic.name: Me
night_message_seyoun_generic.text: *I sent a message to Seoyeon. 'Did you have a good day? See you at school tomorrow.'*

night_message_seyoun_reply_lunch.name: Seoyeon
night_message_seyoun_reply_lunch.text: *Ding~ An instant reply.* 'Really? I'm glad! I should be thanking you for enjoying the food. Look forward to tomorrow too!'

night_message_seyoun_reply_standard.name: Seoyeon
night_message_seyoun_reply_standard.text: *Ding~ An instant reply.* 'I had a great time too! Having you around made me feel so reassured, {name}. See you at school tomorrow!'

night_message_seyoun_reply_high.name: Seoyeon
night_message_seyoun_reply_high.text: *A reply came with a heart emoji.* 'You know... I keep thinking about the time we spent together today. I can't help it. I want to see you, even if it's in a dream.'

night_message_seyoun_reply_low.name: Seoyeon
night_message_seyoun_reply_low.text: *A short reply arrived after a while.* 'Oh... yeah. See you at school tomorrow.'

night_message_seyoun_followup.name: Me
night_message_seyoun_followup.text: *I stared at Seoyeon's reply for a long time. I want to say something more...*
choices: Send 'What do you want to eat tomorrow?'

night_message_seyoun_followup_food.name: Seoyeon
night_message_seyoun_followup_food.text: *Instant reply.* 'Oh, already worried about tomorrow's lunch? How cute lol. Just wait and see — I might pack a surprise lunchbox!'

night_message_seyoun_followup_goodnight.name: Seoyeon
night_message_seyoun_followup_goodnight.text: *A reply after a moment.* 'Yeah... good night, {name}. Sweet dreams.'

night_message_seyoun_followup_end.name: Me
night_message_seyoun_followup_end.text: *I can't believe how natural it feels talking with Seoyeon. Making a friend like this on the very first day... it makes me happy.*

night_message_yuna.name: Me
night_message_yuna.text: *I sent a message to Yuna. 'I had a nice time today. Sleep well.'*

night_message_yuna_reply_standard.name: Yuna
night_message_yuna_reply_standard.text: *A reply arrived after a while.* '...Yeah. You too, good night. See you at school tomorrow, {name}.'

night_message_yuna_reply_high.name: Yuna
night_message_yuna_reply_high.text: *A reply arrived after a while.* 'Today... yeah, thank you. I think I was able to smile a little because of you. Good night.'

night_message_yuna_reply_low.name: Yuna
night_message_yuna_reply_low.text: *No reply. Only the 'read' indicator is showing.*

night_message_yuna_cryptic.name: Yuna
night_message_yuna_cryptic.text: *Another message arrived.* '...By the way, {name}. If you can see the stars tonight, look at the third one. I'll tell you why later.'

night_message_yuna_cryptic_react.name: Me
night_message_yuna_cryptic_react.text: *The third star...? What does she mean? Yuna says these riddle-like things sometimes.*

night_message_yuna_cryptic_choice.name: Me
choices: Send 'Got it, I'll make sure to look.'

night_message_yuna_cryptic_reply.name: Me
night_message_yuna_cryptic_reply.text: *I replied 'Got it. I'll make sure to look.' ...I actually glance out the window, and a few stars are visible. The third star is... that one?*

night_message_yuna_cryptic_ask.name: Yuna
night_message_yuna_cryptic_ask.text: *Reply.* '...If I tell you now, the wish won't come true. Just look.'

night_message_yuna_cryptic_end.name: Yuna
night_message_yuna_cryptic_end.text: *One last reply.* '...Did you see it? Then that's enough. You'll have good dreams, probably.'

night_message_dain_date.name: Me
night_message_dain_date.text: *I sent a message to Dain. 'The tteokbokki today was seriously good! Let's go again sometime haha'*

night_message_dain_generic.name: Me
night_message_dain_generic.text: *I sent a message to Dain. 'You looked awesome at practice today! See you tomorrow.'*

night_message_dain_reply_date.name: Dain
night_message_dain_reply_date.text: *An enthusiastic reply came instantly.* 'Right?! I told you I know all the best spots! Next time we're adding sundae too!'

night_message_dain_reply_standard.name: Dain
night_message_dain_reply_standard.text: *An enthusiastic reply came instantly.* 'Oh, you were watching? How embarrassing! Haha, I'll show you something even cooler tomorrow. Good night, {name}!'

night_message_dain_reply_high.name: Dain
night_message_dain_reply_high.text: *An enthusiastic reply came instantly.* 'Already fallen for my skills? Hehe, I'll make you fall even harder tomorrow! Don't be shocked if I show up in your dreams.'

night_message_dain_selfie.name: Dain
night_message_dain_selfie.text: *A photo arrived. It's a selfie of her flashing a peace sign in the gym.* 'Today's me! Pretty cool, right? lol'

night_message_dain_selfie_react.name: Me
night_message_dain_selfie_react.text: *Dain's selfie... her energy practically radiates from the photo. I couldn't help but smile.*

night_message_dain_challenge.name: Dain
night_message_dain_challenge.text: *Another message.* 'Oh, right! How about a race up the stairs behind the school tomorrow morning? Loser buys snacks! You in?'

night_message_dain_challenge_choice.name: Me
night_message_dain_challenge_choice.text: *A challenge from Dain. What should I do?*

night_message_dain_challenge_accept.name: Dain
night_message_dain_challenge_accept.text: *Instant reply.* 'Ooh!! That's the spirit!! You gotta come early tomorrow, okay? Oversleep and it's a forfeit! Good night, you got this!'

night_message_dain_challenge_tease.name: Dain
night_message_dain_challenge_tease.text: *Instant reply.* 'What?! lol Big talk! Alright, we'll see about that!! Meet me at the front gate tomorrow morning! Good niiiight!!'

night_message_nurse.name: Me
night_message_nurse.text: *I sent a message to the School Nurse. 'Thank you for today, Teacher. I was able to rest comfortably.'*

night_message_nurse_reply_standard.name: School Nurse
night_message_nurse_reply_standard.text: *A charming reply arrived.* 'Oh my, you actually messaged? Our transfer student is so sweet.'

night_message_nurse_reply_high.name: School Nurse
night_message_nurse_reply_high.text: *A charming reply arrived.* 'My goodness... a message like this at night? Are you trying to keep me up? Just kidding. I really like this sweet side of you.'

night_message_nurse_extra_1.name: School Nurse
night_message_nurse_extra_1.text: 'By the way, aren't you worn out from adjusting to the new school? Don't push yourself too hard. If you get a headache or anything, come straight to the nurse's office.'

night_message_nurse_extra_2.name: Me
night_message_nurse_extra_2.text: *I replied 'Yes, thank you! Please get a good rest too, Teacher.' ...It's really warm how she quietly looks out for me.*

night_message_nurse_extra_3.name: School Nurse
night_message_nurse_extra_3.text: 'Thank you. Well then, good night, {name}. I'll wish you sweet dreams.'

night_message_nurse_extra_4.name: Me
night_message_nurse_extra_4.text: *Her saying 'I'll wish you sweet dreams' lingers in my mind. She's a teacher, but... why is my heart racing like this?*

night_goodnight_start.name: Me
night_goodnight_start.text: *I set my phone down and sit up in bed. Maybe I'll open the window for a moment before I sleep.*

night_goodnight_window.name: Me
night_goodnight_window.text: *I open the window, and a cool night breeze brushes my face. A few stars are scattered across the night sky. You can see the stars so much better here than in the city.*

night_goodnight_sounds.name: Me
night_goodnight_sounds.text: *I can hear crickets chirping. A faint train whistle in the distance... this quiet night feels somehow peaceful.*

night_goodnight_think.name: Me
night_goodnight_think.text: *What will tomorrow bring... I'm looking forward to it.*

night_goodnight_close.name: Me
night_goodnight_close.text: *I close the window and crawl under the covers. If I close my eyes... sleep should come soon.*

night_surprise_check.name: Me
night_surprise_check.text: *Just as I'm about to close my eyes — ding! My phone buzzes with a notification. Who could it be at this hour...?*

night_surprise_seyoun.name: Seoyeon
night_surprise_seyoun.text: *A message from Seoyeon.* 'I can't sleep so... do you want to meet at the front gate tomorrow and walk to school together?'

night_surprise_seyoun_react.name: Me
night_surprise_seyoun_react.text: *I replied 'Sure! I'll see you at the front gate tomorrow.' ...Seoyeon reached out first. That somehow makes me feel really happy.*

night_surprise_yuna.name: Yuna
night_surprise_yuna.text: *A message from Yuna.* '...Are you still awake? The stars are pretty tonight. That's all I wanted to say.'

night_surprise_yuna_react.name: Me
night_surprise_yuna_react.text: *I replied 'I was just looking at the stars too.' ...The thought that we're looking at the same sky is unexpectedly exciting.*

night_surprise_dain.name: Dain
night_surprise_dain.text: *A message from Dain.* 'You're still up, right?! Don't forget about tomorrow's race!! You should probably stretch beforehand lol. Good night!'

night_surprise_dain_react.name: Me
night_surprise_dain_react.text: *I replied 'Don't worry, I'm ready!' Dain's energy really never fades, even at night.*

night_surprise_nurse.name: School Nurse
night_surprise_nurse.text: *A message from the School Nurse.* 'If you're still up, that's no good. Should I give you a sleep consultation at the nurse's office tomorrow? Just kidding. Good night.'

night_surprise_nurse_react.name: Me
night_surprise_nurse_react.text: *I replied 'I'm going to sleep now! Thank you, Teacher.' ...She's playful, but she's genuinely worried about me, isn't she?*

night_surprise_teacher.name: Homeroom Teacher
night_surprise_teacher.text: *A message from the Homeroom Teacher.* 'Are you still awake by any chance? I wanted to let you know the schedule changed. 3rd period is PE now. Good night!'

night_surprise_teacher_react.name: Me
night_surprise_teacher_react.text: *I replied 'Thank you, Teacher! Good night!' She's so attentive and thoughtful. What a kind person.*

night_surprise_react.name: Me
night_surprise_react.text: *That surprised me, but... it made me happy. I flip my phone face-down and pull up the covers. Today was truly a wonderful day.*

day1_end.name: Me
day1_end.text: *I look back on today. New encounters, unfamiliar feelings... What kind of day will tomorrow be?*
